observations: Black electric bicycle with a large battery pack mounted on the frame.
The bike is parked indoors on a wooden floor.
The front wheel has a white reflective strip on the tire.
The rear wheel has a 'KICKSTART' brand name on the tire sidewall.
The handlebars have a rearview mirror and a small front-mounted light.
The battery appears to be a custom or third-party unit, not a standard Bosch or Shimano model.
No brand name or model number is visible on the frame or battery.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The battery may be degraded or have a significantly reduced capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike powered on and the speedometer reading while the battery is running down.
risks.if_unproven: as having a dead or failing battery

risks.risk: The motor may be weak or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the bike moving forward without pedaling.

risks.risk: The electronics (controller, display) may be faulty.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the LCD screen while the bike is running.

risks.risk: The frame may have hidden cracks or structural damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame joints and the underside of the bike.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike powered on and moving.
Photo of the LCD screen while the bike is running.
Close-up photos of the frame joints and the underside.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
